title: The Dilworth scavenger hunt
subtitle: Saturday, October 17 · 10 AM · free, all ages
details_html:
Twenty clues hidden across Dilworth. One golden duck. Glory forever.

Teams of up to 4. Start at the Latta Park gazebo, finish wherever the last clue takes you. First team back with the golden duck wins the trophy (a spray-painted duck, obviously).

Free to play. Bring a phone for photos and comfortable shoes.

The rules

Teams of up to 4. No cars — feet and bikes only. The golden duck must be carried, not hidden, once found.

What to bring

A phone for photo clues, comfortable shoes, and a healthy suspicion of garden gnomes.

Rain plan

Light rain: we hunt. Downpour: we postpone to Sunday and eat the trophy duck's feelings.
contact_html: Text to enter your team by Friday night.
verdict_answer: You found the golden duck. Obviously.
